problem: A particle of mass $2\,\text{kg}$ is attached to a massless spring. The spring constant associated with the spring is $k=18\,{\text{kg/s}}^{2}.$  The particle is also subject to a resistive force that's proportional to the particle's speed, and has a damping coefficient $c=10\,\text{kg/s}.$  The position of the particle is $y(t)$ (measured in meters), and $t>0$ is the time in seconds.  If the particle moves with damped harmonic motion, what is the governing equation?
